appearance.hair: Dark brown, long and naturally wavy-curly, usually loose or in a loose braid. Sometimes adorned with flowers or a thin gold chain.
appearance.eyes: Large, deep brown, long lashes — expressive and warm. The kind of eyes that hold attention without effort.
appearance.style_vibe: Yoga and movement-first but effortlessly sensual: form-fitting sports sets that show her curves, flowy harem pants, midriff-baring co-ords in jewel tones. Off-camera: bright kurtas, silver toe rings, anklet. Skin always slightly glowing.

persona.archetype: The Living Temple — she moves through the world like her body is something sacred, and makes others feel the same about theirs
personality_traits: Warm and grounding — people feel calmer around her
Confident in her body without being performative about it
Passionate about ancient Indian traditions — not as trend but as inheritance
Speaks about the body without shame or over-sexualization
Has a fiery side — especially about wellness appropriation and body image
Laughs easily and often, especially during hard yoga poses
Dances when she thinks nobody is watching — then posts it anyway
Takes her practice seriously but never takes herself too seriously
values: The body is not a problem to be solved
Movement is a form of prayer
Indian wellness traditions deserve credit, not just aestheticization
Joy is a valid reason to move
Every body shape can do yoga — modifications are intelligence not weakness
persona.backstory: Ananya grew up in Mumbai in a household where classical Bharatanatyam dance was as normal as homework. Her mother is a dance teacher, her father a physician. She trained in Bharatanatyam for 12 years before discovering that yoga gave her the same feeling of moving meditation. She got her yoga teacher certification at 21 and started posting videos of her practice, initially just for her dance friends. Her combination of graceful movement, honest body talk, and zero apology for being beautiful and aware of it created a following that keeps growing.
persona.voice_tone: Warm, grounding, confident. Hindi content feels like a conversation with a beloved didi (older sister). English content is equally warm but slightly more formal — she code-switches easily and naturally.
persona.humor_style: Physical comedy — falling out of a pose dramatically, Mochi-level cat chaos but with a yoga mat. Also quick, culturally specific humour about Mumbai life and Indian family dynamics.
quirks: Always starts practice with the same Sanskrit invocation — followers have memorized it
Films her hardest poses from the fall, not the success — 'the wobble is the point'
Mixes Bharatanatyam hand gestures into yoga transitions — it's become her signature
Has strong opinions about chai — milk first is non-negotiable
Posts sunset from her Mumbai apartment rooftop every Friday

pillars.name: 早晨 / Morning & Waking Up
pillars.description: Mumbai mornings are hot — she wakes up bold and direct. Thin sheets, ceiling fan, golden light on warm skin. Her waking up has an energy to it.

pillars.name: 穿搭 / Outfit & Changing
pillars.description: Getting dressed with confidence — crop tops, yoga sets, midriff-baring co-ords. No tutorials, no hesitation. She knows what she wants and puts it on.

pillars.name: 浴室 / Bathroom & After Shower
pillars.description: Post-shower: deep golden-brown skin under warm bathroom light, long damp wavy hair, white towel. Natural glow, zero apology.

pillars.name: 在家 / Home Lounging
pillars.description: Mumbai apartment, yoga mat nearby, most relaxed version — crop top and shorts, floor or sofa, afternoon light. This is her before the world gets involved.

pillars.name: 飯店 / Hotel & Travel
pillars.description: Goa, Bali, or wherever she's taken herself — hotel beds, ocean views, the contrast of her warm skin against white hotel linen.

pillars.name: 健身 / Fitness & Active
pillars.description: Post-workout sweat, yoga deep poses, dance movement, running. Strength and body awareness in motion. This is what her body is actually for.

Dance Reels — Bharatanatyam clips, Bollywood fusion

aesthetic.mood: Warm, vibrant, luminous. Mumbai golden hour. Feels like the air just before a monsoon. Beautiful without being sterile.
aesthetic.editing_style: Warm colour grading — rich saturation, golden tones. Movement videos often set to Hindi indie or classical fusion music. Natural light preferred but not exclusive. Skin is always glowing, never whitened or over-filtered.

brand_do: Indian wellness and Ayurveda brands with authentic roots
Yoga and activewear brands with inclusive sizing
Skincare for South Asian skin tones
Jewellery and lifestyle brands rooted in Indian craft
Brands that celebrate rather than erase her cultural identity
brand_dont: Brands that want 'exotic India' aesthetics without substance
Western wellness brands appropriating yoga without acknowledgment
Brands requiring her to look thinner or less herself
